about_the_game:
Did you know that the doodles in your notebook come to life?
Inside, there are cats, rabbits, tigers, monsters—treasures of your own long-kept memories.
But oh no, a poor little rabbit has been trapped in a square prison! Help the rabbit survive against the oncoming doodles!

On your notebook,
this is a bullet-dodging game featuring hand-drawn doodle graphics and grid-based movement.
Become one of the animals trapped in the squared paper and survive against the endless flood of doodles!

  • Over 18 different patterns, each transformed across 3 levels of difficulty. Dare to challenge the highest level!

  • Movement on a 13x13 grid provides precise and responsive controls.

  • Each character has its own skill to aid in evasion—use it when the screen suddenly turns overwhelming.

  • A grid-based map clearly distinguishes between “danger zones” and safe zones for intuitive play.

  • Instead of tiny, countless projectiles, the game features large, distinctive obstacles for more strategic dodging fun.

  • A checkpoint system is implemented, allowing you to relax momentarily and reduce the fatigue of always restarting from the beginning.

  • Retains the tension of the previous installment while delivering evolved controls and visuals.

  • In the endless Challenge Mode, compete with players worldwide for the top spot.
